local({
  answered <- cbind(!is.na(a4_1) | !is.na(a6_1), !is.na(a4_2) | !is.na(a6_2), !is.na(a4_3) | !is.na(a6_3))
  products <- do.call(
    cbind,
    Map(
      function(a4, a6, rating, violence) {
        grade <- case_when(
          is.na(rating) ~ NA_real_,
          as.numeric(rating) %in% 6 ~ 3,
          as.numeric(rating) %in% c(4, 5) ~ 2,
          as.numeric(violence) %in% 1 ~ 1,
          .default = 0
        )
        hours <- if_else(
          coalesce(as.numeric(a4), 0) %in% c(1, 2, 3),
          recode_values(as.numeric(a6), 1 ~ 0, 2 ~ 0.5, 3 ~ 1, 4 ~ 2, 5 ~ 3, 6 ~ 4, 7 ~ 5, 8 ~ 6, 9 ~ 7),
          0
        )
        grade * hours
      },
      list(a4_1, a4_2, a4_3),
      list(a6_1, a6_2, a6_3),
      list(rc_game_01_rating_PEGI, rc_game_02_rating_PEGI, rc_game_03_rating_PEGI),
      list(rc_game_01_violence_PEGI, rc_game_02_violence_PEGI, rc_game_03_violence_PEGI)
    )
  )
  products[!answered] <- NA
  rated <- rowSums(!is.na(products))
  case_when(
    as.numeric(a2) == 2 ~ 0,
    rowSums(answered) == 0 ~ NA_real_,
    2 * rated >= rowSums(answered) ~ rowSums(products, na.rm = TRUE),
    .default = NA_real_
  )
})
notes: Adolescent self-report, single occasion: the study's preregistered PEGI sensitivity score rebuilt from the items, because the released game_sensitive_time multiplies every game by the third game's hours. For each of the three games played most in the past month, a grade from its official PEGI rating as coded by the study team (3 PEGI 18, code 6; 2 PEGI 16 or 17, codes 4-5; 1 violence descriptor 'The game contains depictions of violence'; 0 otherwise; code 6 in games 2-3 is labelled 'PEGI 17' but holds PEGI 18 titles and the study scores it 3) times usual free-time hours a day in it (a6_1-a6_3, scored as st_game: half an hour 0.5, top band 'About 7 or more hours a day' = 7), summed over rated games (range 0-63), higher = more exposure. Used where at least half the games answered about (device or hours given) have a PEGI rating; non-players (a2 = No) 0, the index's no-exposure value; NA where no game was named. Hours of violent gaming (game_violent_time, violent_game_time_esrb) are on st_violent_game.
